title: Project Static

body:
# **READ!** Project Static is not longer gonna be updated. Please use "Pinky" pack


Project Static – A Vibrant Minecraft Experience

Project Static is a carefully curated modpack built for players who want to enhance their Minecraft experience without sacrificing performance or fun. Whether you're a solo adventurer, a builder, or someone who loves hanging out with friends, Project Static delivers a visually stunning, smooth, and socially engaging world.

Why Project Static?

Performance First: Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and other optimization mods, Project Static boosts FPS and minimizes lag—even on lower-end machines—so you can enjoy Minecraft the way it was meant to be played: smooth and responsive.

Visual Upgrades: With Iris Shaders support and optional shader packs, your world will come to life with gorgeous lighting, realistic shadows, and immersive skies—all without bogging down your system.

Built for Fun: This pack isn’t just about looks. It includes lightweight gameplay-enhancing mods that spice up the vanilla experience while staying true to its charm. You get the best of both worlds: performance and playability.

Stay Connected: Integrated proximity voice chat (via Simple Voice Chat) makes multiplayer feel more alive. Whisper secrets, shout across valleys, or casually chat while mining together—communication has never been this immersive.

Easy to Use, Easy to Love: No clutter, no unnecessary bloat. Just a clean, polished modpack that makes Minecraft better in every way!
